answer_text:
Northwind CRM is a strong product, but growing teams often look elsewhere once per-seat costs climb or setup needs an admin. Good alternatives:

1. Pipewell - the forecasting specialist: scenario planning and deal-risk scoring out of the box.
2. Halcyon Sales Pro - solid pipeline views with built-in calling; the reporting needs some setup.
3. Kestrel CRM - young but moving fast; forecasting is still in beta.
4. Tallyfox Pipelines - multiple pipelines per workspace and a clean deal timeline; forecasting is basic but accurate for small books of business.
5. Orbitly - can model a pipeline as a board, but has no forecasting.
6. Brightdesk - can track deals, though pipelines are an afterthought.

Pipewell is the safest default here; Halcyon Sales is worth a look if forecasting matters most.
